result.summary: Found 1 major content issue: an invalid '-100%' discount badge displayed on the bottom restaurant card.

issues.description: The pizza restaurant card at the bottom of the 'Popular right now' section displays an unrealistic '-100%' promotional discount badge, likely caused by a broken discount calculation or invalid promo data.
issues.suggestion: Validate promotional discount values before rendering badges and fix the underlying percentage calculation so invalid 100%-off discounts are not shown.
